About this space
This unique place has a style of its own.
Enjoy your stay in this compact studio apartment designed for sleeping, eating & dining.

The kitchenette is fully equipped with a gas hob, mini fridge, & microwave. There is a separate bathroom with a shower.

TV with DSTV (cable TV) is available, as well as wifi access.

For backup electricity, there is a solar system

The studio apartment is attached to the main house, with its own outside entrance, & parking on site.

The space
Mafiris Studio is a bedsitter fully equipped for an enjoyable stay. In one room, you can cook , dine, and sleep, and there is a separate bathroom with a shower.

TV with DSTV access is available for guest entertainment, as well as wifi access

There is solar for when there is a power outage as well as a fuel powered generator . Hot water for showering is via an electric/solar geyser

Mafiris Studio is attached to the main house but has its own outside entrance

Guest access
There is a garden that is shared by all 4 units at the property. Guests can relax and take a walk around the garden . As the garden is shared by all guests in different units, we ask our guests to be considerate in terms of maintaining low noise levels so that other guests are not disturbed

Other things to note
The studio has a solar/electricity combo geyser for hot water.

Parking for guests with their own car is on site. Access is via an electric gate.

There is a solar system that we use when there is a power outage. It powers the outside lights, wifi , Studio lights, & TV. It also powers booster pump, which ensures that there is water from the 5,000L storange tank into the Studio for guests' use.

There is also an electric powered borehole, so water is always available

(note that you can not iron nor use the fridge when solar is in use)
